lead: Competitive intelligence signals across the rolling year highlight active EFB, flight planning, and dispatch developments, led by significant customer wins for IFS and Jeppesen alongside steady product releases from Aviobook, Bytron Skybook, Lufthansa Systems, and Navblue.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional Carrier EFB Wins
insights.finding: IFS captured multiple customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform, notably signing low-cost carriers MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet, as well as TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) and fastjet are classified as low-cost carriers (LCCs), while TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured text indicates public announcements and press releases; implementation timelines vary.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands Major Airline Flight Planning Agreements
insights.finding: Jeppesen secured notable agreements for its flight planning and dispatch suites, including a fleet-wide selection by Korean Air and launching Dispatch v2026-2 with Corendon Airlines.
insights.aviation_context: Korean Air operates an integrated widebody and narrowbody fleet exceeding 230 aircraft.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect major contract milestones but do not detail phased rollout schedules.

insights.title: Aviobook and Bytron Skybook Roll Out EFB Version Updates
insights.finding: Aviobook released AvioBook 26.3 with customizable seat swap confirmations, while Bytron Skybook issued version 1.52.0 featuring updated checklists, fuel fields, and performance data.
insights.aviation_context: These updates target cockpits and ground portals to refine crew workflows and flight data handling.
insights.caveat: Feature sets depend on individual airline configuration choices.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Deploys Lido Solutions Across International Carriers
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems advanced its Lido flight planning and EFB deployments, implementing Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways and deploying the Lido mPilot EFB for Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Lido Flight 4D and mPilot provide integrated flight planning and digital chart navigation.
insights.caveat: Captured implementation announcements confirm deployment milestones rather than full operational integration status.

insights.title: Navblue Expands Skywise Integration with TransNusa
insights.finding: Navblue expanded its collaboration with TransNusa, securing agreements for Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ to integrate flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: Skywise Core X2 and Fleet Performance+ link operational and technical data for fleet health monitoring.
insights.caveat: Agreements mark initial product adoption for the specified region.
